name: nvoos/wifi
description: AI-powered social WiFi and Wi-Fi observability: captive portal, per-purpose consent, device-identity sessions and Wi-Fi Data Elements-shaped KPIs. Portable across the WordPress and Laravel NV oOS runtimes.

extra._comment_type: type=library is deliberate. With type=wordpress-plugin and composer/installers present, this package would be relocated into wp-content/plugins when required from the Laravel app. See Proposal 150 decision OQ-2.
extra._comment_runtime: The WordPress host loads includes/Plugin.php directly from nvoos-wifi.php; the Laravel host requires this package through a path repository and binds the interfaces to its own implementations.
extra._comment_classmap: exclude-from-classmap keeps the WordPress-only trees out of an optimised Composer classmap (app/Wifi in the Laravel host never references them). Note this does not disable PSR-4 resolution -- the standing rule is simply that no Laravel code may reference NvoosWifi\Infrastructure\Wp\*, NvoosWifi\REST\* or WP_MCP_AI_Tool_*.
